Let me extract the files into a working tree.

The two failing tests are the only ones that use Robolectric. They fail because Gradle runs your unit tests on Java 17, and Robolectric 4.18.1 needs Java 21 to simulate Android 16 and 17 (API 36/37). You can see that rule in Robolectric's `DefaultSdkProvider.java` at line 172. CI didn't hit this because it already uses JDK 21; your Fedora machine runs Gradle on 17.

The fix makes the unit tests always run on JDK 21. Gradle uses an installed JDK 21 if it finds one, and otherwise downloads one once through the Foojay plugin (Apache-2.0). The app itself still compiles for Java 17, so nothing changes for the APK.

I haven't run these changes, because my sandbox can't reach Maven Central or Google Maven. Please re-run your command chain to confirm.

**Dependency upgrades:** I didn't bump any versions. I couldn't check Maven Central or Google Maven, and the release pages I could reach lag behind your pinned versions (for example AGP 9.5.2 and Compose BOM 2026.11.01). Since your build resolves all current pins, I left them alone rather than guess. Dependabot will raise PRs for anything newer. The GitHub Actions are already on the versions your project spec names.

There are 5 changed files and nothing to delete. They're also in the tar.gz; extract it at the repo root.
